intro.text: T and Y are stretch keys for your index fingers, just like G and H, but one row up.
intro.tip: Stretch, press, return. Your index fingers come back to F and J every time.

steps.title: Meet T and Y
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: ftf jyj ftf jyj ttt yyy the yes try they tidy
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Real words
steps.instructions: Every word uses only keys you have learnt.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: they sat at the lake; it is a tidy shed; her kitty is shy; the sky is dark; fresh fruit is tasty;
the first day is the hardest; try harder; they like the sea air; a little tree is tall; stay steady;
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
